field_principles.effective_sample_sizes_and_uncertainty_r: Sample-size and interval checks keep underpowered cells visible.

field_principles.eligibility:public_factor_claim: Public factor eligibility cannot exceed prospective CSL eligibility.
field_principles.event_and_raw_output_uniqueness_rechecks: Fresh event and raw-output checks attack reuse and duplicate evidence.
field_principles.expected_and_available_upstream_inputs: The input ledger makes missing and available evidence visible.
field_principles.field_principles: Field principles state why each field exists.
field_principles.field_provenance: Field provenance links fields to specs, rows, sidecars, attacks, tests, or commands.
field_principles.harm_underpowered_missing_and_flagged_ce: Weak, missing, null, and flagged cells remain visible.
field_principles.held_freeze_and_restart_rechecks: Held freeze and restart checks attack retuning and lost persistence.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict uses a terminal prefix and states the audit result.
field_principles.independently_recomputed_development_cap: Independent reductions keep positive summaries from being trusted.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate declares deterministic checked-in row replay with no new LLM.
field_principles.mismatch_count: A nonzero mismatch count blocks claim eligibility.
field_principles.missing_input_findings: Missing rows remain visible and never become zeros.
field_principles.missing_input_rule:missing_not_zero: Missing rows stay missing and never enter numerators as zero.
field_principles.missing_input_rule:no_denominator_drop: Missing rows stay in the visibility ledger and do not vanish from denominators.
field_principles.open_critical_attack_ids: Open critical attacks and current critical flags block claim eligibility.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Audit rows cover every source unit and every comparison.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Preconditions record resources, repository state, inputs, and specs checked before eligibility.
field_principles.prospective_csl_claim_eligibility: Eligibility is true only when rows, recomputation, safety, attacks, and current flags all pass.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Protected files must stay byte-identical during the audit.
field_principles.public_factor_claim_eligibility: Public factor claims require the prospective CSL claim to be eligible first.
field_principles.random_seed: The random seed pins deterministic row ordering and attack receipts.
field_principles.recompute:development_capacity: Development capacity metrics come from Exp6430 row and sidecar evidence.
field_principles.recompute:held: Held metrics come from Exp6432 per-unit rows.
field_principles.recompute:interference: Interference metrics come from Exp6431 per-unit rows.
field_principles.reported_vs_recomputed_deltas: Deltas expose each reported value, tolerance, denominator, and mismatch reason.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum detects drift in the audit payload.
field_principles.retention_forgetting_contamination_growt: Safety and cost checks prevent utility from hiding harm.
field_principles.retirement:same_verdict: Same-verdict retirement must preserve earlier null and flag determinations.
field_principles.same_verdict_retirement_decision: The retirement decision preserves null history without hiding V553 blockers.
field_principles.status: The status separates an eligible claim from a null or blocked audit.
field_principles.tests_run: Test commands and exit codes prevent unverifiable success claims.
field_principles.upstream_artifact_row_manifest_raw_sourc: Hashes bind every artifact, row block, sidecar, raw output, source, checker, helper, head, and determination.
field_principles.upstream_state_by_task: Task states preserve present, missing, skipped, blocked, null, flagged, underpowered, and eligible inputs.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: The audit is not an oracle, although exact validators are audited semantic oracles.
